content.query:
SELECT TOP 10 
DF.CIF_ID AS CUST_ID, CUST.NAME AS CUST_NAME, CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1, CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2, CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3, SUM(YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP) AS YTD_ADB_PHP
FROM eds.DEPOSIT_FACT DF
	LEFT JOIN eds.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
		ON DF.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
		AND DF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY
		AND DF.GAM_BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID
WHERE DF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND SUBSTRING(DF.CIF_ID, 1, 1) = 'R' AND DF.AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) FROM eds.DEPOSIT_FACT)
AND
(
CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%FORBES%PARK%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%URDANETA%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%DASMARI_AS%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%CORINTHIAN%GARDENS%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%SAN%LORENZO%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%BEL-AIR%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%VALLE%VERDE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%AYALA%ALABANG%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%WHITE%PLAINS%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%MCKINLEY%HILL%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%MAGALLANES%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%GREENHILLS%VILLAGE%')
OR CONCAT(UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2), ', ', UPPER(CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3)) LIKE ('%LOYOLA%HEIGHTS%')
)
GROUP BY DF.CIF_ID, CUST.NAME, CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1, CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2, CUST.ADDRESS_LINE3
